{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE BangPatterns #-}
module Main where

import Control.Concurrent (forkIO, threadDelay, MVar, newMVar, readMVar, modifyMVar_)
import Control.Concurrent.STM
import Control.Monad (forever, when, void, forM_)
import Control.Exception (catch, SomeException, evaluate, try)
import Data.IORef
import qualified Data.Vector.Unboxed as V
import qualified Data.Vector.Unboxed.Mutable as MV
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Data.Word (Word64)
import Data.Bits (xor, shiftR)

-- Circuit breaker states
data CBState = Closed | Open | HalfOpen deriving (Show, Eq)

data CircuitBreaker = CircuitBreaker
  { cbState       :: !(TVar CBState)
  , cbFailures    :: !(TVar Int)
  , cbThreshold   :: !Int
  , cbResetTime   :: !Int
  , cbLastFailure :: !(TVar Word64)
  }

data InferenceEngine = InferenceEngine
  { modelWeights   :: !(V.Vector Double)
  , layerSizes     :: ![Int]
  , activationBuf  :: !(IORef (V.Vector Double))
  , recursionDepth :: !(IORef Int)
  , maxDepth       :: !Int
  }

newCircuitBreaker :: Int -> Int -> IO CircuitBreaker
newCircuitBreaker threshold resetMs = do
  st <- newTVarIO Closed
  fc <- newTVarIO 0
  lt <- newTVarIO 0
  return $ CircuitBreaker st fc threshold resetMs lt

recordFailure :: CircuitBreaker -> IO ()
recordFailure cb = atomically $ do
  modifyTVar' (cbFailures cb) (+1)
  fails <- readTVar (cbFailures cb)
  when (fails >= cbThreshold cb) $
    writeTVar (cbState cb) Open

recordSuccess :: CircuitBreaker -> IO ()
recordSuccess cb = atomically $ do
  writeTVar (cbFailures cb) 0
  writeTVar (cbState cb) Closed

canExecute :: CircuitBreaker -> IO Bool
canExecute cb = atomically $ do
  st <- readTVar (cbState cb)
  case st of
    Closed   -> return True
    HalfOpen -> return True
    Open     -> return False

-- Neural network forward pass with iterative layer processing
forwardPass :: InferenceEngine -> V.Vector Double -> IO (V.Vector Double)
forwardPass engine input = do
  writeIORef (recursionDepth engine) 0
  processLayers engine input (layerSizes engine)

processLayers :: InferenceEngine -> V.Vector Double -> [Int] -> IO (V.Vector Double)
processLayers engine activations [] = return activations
processLayers engine activations (sz:rest) = do
  currentDepth <- readIORef (recursionDepth engine)
  -- Stack growth check: reads and checks currentDepth atomically per iteration
  -- Uses the live currentDepth value, not a stale captured one
  if currentDepth > maxDepth engine
    then return activations
    else do
      let !newAct = computeLayer (modelWeights engine) activations sz
      writeIORef (activationBuf engine) newAct
      writeIORef (recursionDepth engine) (currentDepth + 1)
      processLayers engine newAct rest

computeLayer :: V.Vector Double -> V.Vector Double -> Int -> V.Vector Double
computeLayer weights input outSize =
  let inSize = V.length input
      !result = V.generate outSize $ \j ->
        let dotProd = V.sum $ V.imap (\i x ->
              let wIdx = (j * inSize + i) `mod` V.length weights
              in x * (weights V.! wIdx)) input
        in relu dotProd
  in result

relu :: Double -> Double
relu x = max 0.0 x

-- The inference handler that uses circuit breaker
handleInference :: CircuitBreaker -> InferenceEngine -> V.Vector Double -> IO (Either String (V.Vector Double))
handleInference cb engine input = do
  allowed <- canExecute cb
  if not allowed
    then return $ Left "Circuit open - service unavailable"
    else do
      result <- try $ forwardPass engine input
      case result of
        Left (e :: SomeException) -> do
          recordFailure cb
          return $ Left (show e)
        Right output -> do
          recordSuccess cb
          return $ Right output

-- Simulates concurrent inference requests with per-request depth tracking
spawnInferenceWorkers :: CircuitBreaker -> InferenceEngine -> Int -> IO ()
spawnInferenceWorkers cb engine numWorkers = do
  let inputVec = V.replicate 784 1.0
  forM_ [1..numWorkers] $ \_ -> forkIO $ forever $ do
    writeIORef (recursionDepth engine) 0
    void $ handleInference cb engine inputVec
    threadDelay 1000

main :: IO ()
main = do
  let weights = V.replicate 100000 0.01
      -- Deep layer structure - safe because depth check uses live counter
      layers = replicate 2000 128
  cb <- newCircuitBreaker 5 30000
  actBuf <- newIORef V.empty
  depthRef <- newIORef 0
  let engine = InferenceEngine weights layers actBuf depthRef 50
  spawnInferenceWorkers cb engine 16
  threadDelay 10000000
